日.name: sun
日.meaningMnemonic: A tall box with a bar across the middle, like a window glowing with light. Picture the sun shining through it, so bright the glass seems split in two.

一.name: plank
一.meaningMnemonic: One flat line lying on its side. It is a single wooden plank laid across a muddy path so you can walk over it.

王.name: monarch
王.meaningMnemonic: Three planks stacked and joined by one upright post, like the frame of a throne. Only a monarch gets to sit on something that sturdy.

囗.name: corral
囗.meaningMnemonic: A big empty square with nothing inside yet. It is a corral, a fenced pen waiting for animals to be herded in.

丶.name: speck
丶.meaningMnemonic: A tiny slanted dot, barely there. It is a speck of dust that landed on your page.

人.name: walker
人.meaningMnemonic: Two strokes leaning on each other like a pair of legs mid stride. This is a walker, always heading somewhere on foot.

ノ.name: swoosh
ノ.meaningMnemonic: One curved stroke sweeping down to the left. Hear the swoosh of a brush flicking across paper.

干.name: drying rack
干.meaningMnemonic: Two crossbars hung on a single post. Laundry gets draped over each bar, so this is a drying rack.

乞.name: beggar
乞.meaningMnemonic: A bent little shape with a hand held out, hunched over and hoping. It is a beggar asking for spare change.

大.name: starfish
大.meaningMnemonic: A figure with arms flung wide and legs spread apart. It looks just like a starfish lying flat on the sand.

十.name: plus sign
十.meaningMnemonic: One line across and one line down, crossing in the middle. It is a plus sign, the same one you use in maths.

二.name: bunk beds
二.meaningMnemonic: Two flat lines, one above the other, the top one shorter. They are bunk beds, a small bunk stacked over a big one.

木.name: timber
木.meaningMnemonic: A trunk standing straight with branches above and roots spreading below. Someone shouts timber as it starts to fall.

｜.name: pole
｜.meaningMnemonic: A single straight line standing upright. It is a pole planted firmly in the ground.

口.name: hatch
口.meaningMnemonic: A small square opening. It is a hatch in a ship's deck that you can pop open and climb through.

長.name: long hair
長.meaningMnemonic: Many lines stream down from the top and flow out at the bottom. It is a head of long hair blowing in the wind.

山.name: three peaks
山.meaningMnemonic: Three points rise from one base, the middle one tallest. It is a ridge with three peaks against the sky.

凵.name: bucket
凵.meaningMnemonic: A shape open at the top with walls on both sides. It is a bucket waiting to be filled.

寸.name: inch
寸.meaningMnemonic: A hand with a dot marking a spot on the wrist, the old way to measure a tiny length. That small measure is an inch.

土.name: soil
土.meaningMnemonic: A short line over a long line with a sprout pushing up between them. The long line is the ground, and the sprout grows out of rich soil.

行.name: crossroads
行.meaningMnemonic: Two halves facing each other with gaps between, like streets meeting from four sides. It is a crossroads in the middle of town.

彳.name: side street
彳.meaningMnemonic: This is only the left half of the crossroads, a narrow lane branching off. Call it a side street.

見.name: watcher
見.meaningMnemonic: A big eye perched on top of two legs. It is a watcher who walks around and stares at everything.

目.name: eyeball
目.meaningMnemonic: A tall box with two bars inside, like an eye turned on its side. Picture a round eyeball rolling inside it.

儿.name: stilts
儿.meaningMnemonic: Two long legs and nothing else, one bending out at the bottom. Someone is wobbling along on stilts.

月.name: crescent
月.meaningMnemonic: A tall shape with a curved side and two bars inside. It is a thin crescent hanging in the night sky.

夂.name: dragging feet
夂.meaningMnemonic: A slanted shape that seems to trail behind itself. It is someone walking slowly on dragging feet, in no hurry at all.

幺.name: tiny thread
幺.meaningMnemonic: Two little loops twisted together. It is a tiny thread curled up after being pulled from a sweater.

刈.name: sickle
刈.meaningMnemonic: A sharp blade on one side, ready to cut grain. It is a sickle swinging through a field.

并.name: antlers
并.meaningMnemonic: Two short strokes point up and outward at the top. They are a pair of antlers poking out above a head.

生.name: seedling
生.meaningMnemonic: Lines branch up from the soil like small leaves reaching for light. It is a seedling just breaking through.

五.name: high five
五.meaningMnemonic: A shape with an open frame like a raised palm. Slap it for a high five.

門.name: saloon doors
門.meaningMnemonic: Two matching panels side by side with a gap between. They are saloon doors that swing open when you push through.

卜.name: fortune stick
卜.meaningMnemonic: A straight stick with a short mark sticking off one side. It is a fortune stick shaken from a cup to tell your future.

田.name: paddy
田.meaningMnemonic: A square split into four smaller squares. It is a paddy seen from above, divided into flooded plots.
